verdict.rationale: Open-sourcing a product's code under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS email platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions MailerSend's source being available or any open license. The reference to 'official libraries' covers client SDKs, not the product's own source, and gives no license terms, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
